info.description:
Packio — Your Packaging Production Partner, operated by Collective Group (Thailand).
Rules: `docs/contract/api-conventions.md` (shared with packio-web).

- **Surfaces:** `/v1/auth`, `/v1/store` (customer), `/v1/admin` (staff), `/v1/partner` (factories), `/v1/b2b` (company API clients, D-291), `/webhooks`. A token is accepted only on its own audience's prefix.
- **Money:** decimal strings with exactly 2 decimals (`"1234.50"`) plus `currency: "THB"` on the object; never JSON numbers. Clients never compute prices.
- **Dates:** ISO 8601 with offset, rendered in `Asia/Bangkok` (`2026-09-22T14:05:00+07:00`); date-only fields `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **IDs:** uuid only; business keys (`orderCode`) are separate fields.
- **Errors:** RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`; `title`/`detail` localised by `Accept-Language` (`th` default, `en`).
- **Lists:** `?page&perPage(≤100)&sort&order&q` → `{ data, meta: { page, perPage, total } }`; feeds use `?cursor&limit` → `{ data, meta: { nextCursor } }`.
- **Idempotency:** irreversible POSTs require `Idempotency-Key` (uuid); replays within 24 h return the original response.
- **Concurrency:** editable resources return `ETag`; updates send `If-Match` (412 `concurrency.stale`).
- **Files:** presign → PUT to the returned URL → reference the `fileId`.

Each release (≥ the factory’s minimum order, ≤ what is left) is a quotation at the locked unit price — product only, shipping priced at checkout; the first release carries the quotation’s one-off amounts — and a normal order with the normal payment schedule (D-020). No deposit, no stock; what is not released lapses at expiry without charge (D-290).

Implements: D-290, D-206, D-141.

`start-review`: `applied → under_review`. `return-to-applicant`: `under_review → applied`, e.g. for missing documents; the reason is shown on the partner timeline. `start-trial`: `under_review → trial` (or back from `suspended`): the factory may take trial jobs (D-076 first 3 jobs fully inspected). `suspend`: `trial | active → suspended`: no new work is routed to it. `reinstate`: `suspended → active` (a factory never activated before goes through `start-trial` and activation instead). `offboard`: Final: the factory can no longer receive work. `trial → active` needs `actions/request-activation` (D-041). A reason is required; recorded in the status history.

Implements: D-011, D-041, D-171.

Signed-in customers only, at most `dielines.downloads_per_minute` (5) a minute and `dielines.downloads_per_day` (20) a Bangkok day; beyond them 429 with `Retry-After`. Every download is logged; identical requests reuse the cached drawing (D-271, D-270, D-203). Answers a short-lived signed URL and the dieline quantities. The PDF is the designer PDF (D-302): layers and spot swatches `CutContour`, `Crease`, `Perf`, `Glue`, `Bleed`, `Safe` (+ `HalfCut` when the style has half-cuts), bleed and safe distances of the preflight rules, the style code in the title and metadata.

`{"payload":"<JWT HS256>"}` signed with Packio’s merchant secret; an invalid signature is 401. A success (`respCode 0000`) is confirmed by the 2C2P inquiry before the payment is accepted; replays are no-ops (D-061, D-176).

Implements: D-114, D-013, D-005.

Signed with SHA-256 over `mchId` and `nonceStr` plus Packio’s secret key; stored in the webhook inbox (replays are no-ops) and published as `carrier.webhook_received` (D-114). Answers `{"errorCode":"1"}` when accepted; 401 when the signature is invalid.

Implements: D-114, D-013, D-005.

Sent by LINE for follows, unfollows and messages. Verified with `x-line-signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body with the channel secret), stored once per `webhookEventId` (redeliveries are no-ops). Messages reach the CS inbox (D-151).

Implements: D-151, D-143.

Sent by SCB for a paid QR 30 / QR CS. The callback carries no signature: it is confirmed by the SCB inquiry before the payment is accepted, stored once per `transactionId` (SCB retries 3 times) and answered with `{"resCode":"00"}` (D-061, D-176).

Implements: D-061, D-176.

Queue results of the slip-verification provider. Unsigned, so the result is re-fetched from the provider before it decides a slip still waiting in review; stored once per reference (D-061).
